```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(GAMSr)

m <- gams_model("transport")
i <- gams_set(m, "i", records = c("seattle", "san-diego"))
j <- gams_set(m, "j", records = c("new-york", "chicago", "topeka"))
x <- gams_variable(m, "x", domain = c(i, j), type = "positive")
m
```
